items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dick Bass? [INTERVIEWEE] No, Dick Vance wasn't there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Chu was with the band before I was. That's probably why I was with the band. I think Chu must have told him to get me. Chu, Buster was there, Joe Thomas.
No, Dick Vance wasn't there. A trumpet player named Thigpen. I don't remember Thigpen's first name. Do you know?
